H_transfer: The multiplicity-preserving original coordinate identity gives H squarefreeness and matching derivative valuations; normalized derivative units are not identified.
conclusions: Original algebraic-square kernel nonzero at every P_n root
exact_scope: Every odd prime p; every integer s>3; n=2*p^3+p; every characteristic-zero primitive p^s-th phase q.
finite_reduction_caution: Characteristic-zero simplicity is not simplicity of every finite reduction. For n=57 modulo 163, q=4 of order 81, primitive phase exponents 28 and 29 have repeated gcd degree 2; the other 52 tested primitive phases are simple. The original algebraic-square kernel identity was checked at all 54. These are retained bad-reduction controls, not characteristic-zero exceptions.
normalization: Original P recurrence, Gaussian H, original ordinary characteristic-zero derivatives, original algebraic-square Christoffel-Darboux kernel.
